manualButtonLabel: Choose manual members for the next turn, {n} selected
manualHelp: Checked members run with your next message. The selection clears when that turn starts.

status.awaiting_commit: Waiting for the reply to save

saveError: Could not save the team configuration.
saveAgain: The saved version moved without conflicting changes. Save again.
unsaved: Unsaved changes. They apply from the next turn once saved.
savedNextTurn: Saved. The next team run uses this configuration.
invalidJson: This JSON is malformed or has the wrong shape. Fix it before saving.

notice.saved: Saved. Applies from the next team run.
notice.example: Loaded the “{name}” example. Save to apply it.
notice.exportedDraft: Exported the current draft (not saved yet).

conflictShort: The configuration changed elsewhere. Resolve the conflict first.
conflictHelp: A newer version of this configuration was saved elsewhere, and your changes are not saved. Keep your changes (saving will replace the newer version), or load the newer version and drop yours.
noOtherMembers: There are no other members yet.
publisherHelp: Only this member hands the reply to the chat. Everything else stays inside the team.
memberHasErrors: This member has settings to fix
memberHasMissing: This member references an unavailable model or preset

section.state: State it can read or write

issue.incompleteModel: Choose both a provider and a model, or switch back to the chat model. This can't be saved yet.
issue.missingProvider: This host has no such provider. The original reference is kept; the host checks models on save and rejects ones it can't resolve.
issue.missingModel: The catalog doesn't list this model. The original reference is kept; the host checks it on save.
issue.unsupportedParameters: Some parameters are outside what this model supports; the host may reject the save.
issue.missingPreset: This host can't find the preset. The original reference is kept.
issue.brokenPreset: This preset can't be loaded right now.
issue.noTrigger: No participation is selected, so this member never runs.
issue.condition_invalid: The trigger condition has an invalid shape.
issue.condition_undeclared: The condition uses a state path that isn't defined. Define it in Team settings first.
issue.condition_unreadable: This member can't read the state the condition uses. Grant read access under “State it can read or write”.
issue.oneSided: Some communication is granted by one side only, so it has no effect.
issue.orphanPrivate: A rule points to the private state of a removed member.
issue.unknownCapability: Some tool entries don't exist on this host. They are kept as they are.
issue.incompleteSource: Enter a path beginning with /. Saving is blocked until completed.

name: Name
descriptionHint: One sentence on what this member does. Shown in the member list.
inheritModelHelp: This member uses whichever model the chat has selected.
missingProvider: This host has no such provider. The original reference is kept.
unlistedModel: The catalog doesn't list this model. The original reference is kept.
unsupportedParams: This model doesn't support: {list}. The host rejects unsupported reasoning effort on save; remove it or pick a model that supports it.
presetHint: A preset adds native tools and skills.
missingPreset: This host can't find the preset. The original reference is kept.
brokenPreset: This preset can't be loaded right now.
triggerHelp: Participation decides when this member is picked; dependencies below decide when it can start. Choose any combination.

triggers.manual: Picked manually for the next turn

triggerHints.manual: Runs with the next message after you check it under “Next turn” in the composer.
triggerHints.requested_by_agent: Other members can ask it to run during a turn.
triggerHints.condition: Runs when the selected state meets the condition.
triggerHints.periodic: Uses the current effective branch, including rewinds.
triggerHints.message_received: Checks authorized messages during an explicit run.
triggerHints.keyword: Checks visible current input text only.

requestFromHelp: With none checked, any member allowed to request this one under “Who it talks to” can do so.
afterHelp: Only orders execution; it doesn't make those members run.
continueOnFailure: Skip it and continue the turn
conditionPathHint: JSON Pointer; may be more specific than the chosen state.
conditionValueHint: Write it as JSON, for example 3, "text", or true.
conditionComplex: This is a combined condition (all, any, or not). Edit it as JSON below.
conditionHelp: Supports exists, compare, all, any, and not. It may only use state this member can read.
contextHelp: The member receives only the checked sources. Long-term memory, scene, and hidden state also need read access to their state.

sourceHints.current_input: What the user sent this turn.
sourceHints.full_history: The whole chat; can be long.
sourceHints.worldbook: Worldbook entries relevant to this turn.
sourceHints.agent_messages: Internal messages other members sent to this one.
sourceHints.drafts: Own drafts and drafts explicitly shared by other members this turn.
sourceHints.hidden_state: State the user doesn't see, such as world truth.

stateBackedHint: Also grant read access to the matching path under “State it can read or write”.
selectorHelp: For example /persona/name. A field path is required; choose all content to read the whole source.
scopeNone: No member is selected, so this source provides nothing.
compactionLimitHint: Leave empty for the host default.
communicationHelp: Messages and requests only work when both sides allow them. Receiving a message doesn't make a member run.

communication.sendTo: Can send messages to these members
communication.requestTo: Can request these members to run

gap.sendTo: That member doesn't accept messages from this one
gap.receiveFrom: That member doesn't send messages to this one
gap.requestTo: That member doesn't accept requests from this one, or doesn't run on request
gap.requestFrom: That member isn't allowed to request this one

gapHelp: Marked cells are granted by this member only, so they have no effect.
stateHelp: State without access is invisible to this member. Writes are staged during the turn and committed when the reply is saved.
noStateDefinitions: The team defines no state yet. Define it in Team settings, or write access rules as JSON below.
extraRules: Other path rules (not in the state definitions)

authorityHints.draft: Other members can read drafts, and the reply writer can use them.
authorityHints.state: Only paths marked writable under “State it can read or write”.

isPublisher: This member hands the reply to the chat. To change that, pick another member at the top of the member list or from their page.
notPublisher: This member doesn't write the reply.
makePublisher: Make this member write the reply
capabilitiesInherited: Not set individually; host defaults apply. Changing any item creates an explicit list from the current defaults.
capabilitiesExplicit: Set individually; unchecked tools are unavailable.
emptyCapabilities: The host offers no configurable tools.
unknownCapability: Not offered by this host; kept as is
trustedHelp: Explicitly allow native external tools. Workspace, MCP, and extension tools may reach information outside managed boundaries.
noTrustTools: No tools need explicit trust right now.
capabilityGroupIds: Edit tools and trust as JSON
limitsHelp: Limit concurrency and executions per turn so members can't call each other forever.
stateDefinitionHelp: Keep track of feelings, memories and scenes. Choose a location, content type and initial value, then decide which members can access it.
metadataHelp: Exported with the preset to credit its source. Fields that look like credentials are removed on export.
presetFilesHelp: Exports contain only the preset, author defaults, and dependency declarations — no chats, traces, or credentials. Imports land in the draft and apply once saved.
exampleHint: An example replaces the current draft and applies once saved.
noRunEnabled: Send a message and this page shows how the members worked together.
noRunDisabled: Turn the team on and send a message to see how the members work together.
traceLoadFailed: Could not load the run record.

phaseHelp.preparing: Preparing the members for this turn.
phaseHelp.composing: The reply writer is composing the reply.
phaseHelp.publishing: Handing the reply to the chat.
phaseHelp.awaiting_commit: The reply exists and is waiting for the chat to confirm it saved. It isn't complete until then.
phaseHelp.complete: The reply is saved in the chat.
phaseHelp.cancelled: This turn stopped and was not rerun.

retryDiscardFailed: Withdrawing the retry request also failed.
retryHelp: Retry regenerates the reply from this turn's original input; members that didn't fail reuse their results.
retryLatestOnly: Only the latest run can be retried.
reusedResult: Reused a result from an earlier run; no model call this time.
noTraceEvents: No events recorded for this run yet.
noEventData: This event has no extra data.

events.publication.awaiting_commit: Waiting for native reply to save
events.publication.rewound: Reply rewound; state restored to before publication

sourcePathRequired: Enter a path beginning with /. Saving is blocked until completed.
sourceLimitHint: Leave empty for the source default. Applies to arrays and text; recent history selects from the end.
fullSourceWarning: An “All authorized content” selection is still present. Additional fields do not narrow its existing access.
ownDraftHint: Own drafts remain visible. These choices only filter drafts from other members.
scopeOwnDrafts: No other members selected. Own drafts remain visible.

stateForm.name: State name
stateForm.nameHint: For example mood, memories or stamina. Add groups below. Renaming uses a new location; existing saved values are not moved.
stateForm.descriptionPlaceholder: For example: what the character believes, which may differ from reality.
stateForm.typeHint: The type limits what members can write. Changing to a different type resets the initial value.
stateForm.defaultHint: Used only if this state does not exist yet. Does not overwrite saved conversation state.
stateForm.emptyObject: No fields yet. Keep related details such as mood and intensity together.
stateForm.emptyList: No items yet. Store several memories, people or objects.
stateForm.permissionsHint: Invisible without a grant. Writing also requires the member's state output authority. More specific rules remain available on member pages.
stateForm.inherited: Inherited from a parent rule. Selecting here creates a separate rule.
stateForm.addressHint: The actual address members use. Exact permission and trigger references follow a rename or move; addresses written in prompts need manual changes.
stateForm.wholeStoreHint: Constrain the whole storage area instead of one named field.
stateForm.emptyHint: Start with a text state such as mood, or combine fields and lists into richer structures.
stateForm.invalidSave: State contains unfinished or duplicate content. Fix it before saving.

errors.number: Enter a valid number; do not leave it empty.
errors.duplicateField: Field names in the same collection must be unique.
errors.duplicateState: A state already uses this location. Change its name, group or storage area.

author.handoffHelp: Choose the target, visible fields and continuation. Communication permissions still apply. Requirements validate the whole summary + data envelope.

modeHint.notify: Send a message without waiting or automatically calling the target.
modeHint.await: Call the target, then continue in the same execution. Release the concurrency slot while waiting.
modeHint.resume: Call the target and continue now. Schedule another activation when the result arrives. Both count toward limits.

author.previewHelp: No model calls. Inspect who would run and what they would see from current data and the test input. Future messages and writes depend on the actual execution.
author.previewStale: The draft, input or source data changed. Check again.
author.currentStateHelp: Edit actual state for this chat, separately from defaults in team settings. Member views are read-only.
author.memberViewReadOnly: Shows only the values this member can read. Editing is disabled.
author.stateBusy: A run, commit or read is pending. Editing is unavailable.
author.commitPending: Save outcome is unconfirmed. Check it before submitting again.
author.editStale: Data changed. Your edit is preserved and will be checked for conflicts.
author.checkpointsHelp: Apply values changes state now. Rewind chat asks the host to roll back messages and state.
author.libraryHelp: Store presets locally with immutable versions. Saving here does not change this chat. Load a draft, then save the team configuration.
author.componentsHelp: Export selected members and their rules. Connect external members and state before merging. Permissions are never expanded automatically.
author.dependencyHelp: Model, preset and tool references are preserved. Choose replacements explicitly for missing dependencies.
author.unknownPastValues: Some historical values were not recorded. Select known values; current values will not replace missing history.

params.title: Usage parameters
params.help: Adjust author-provided parameters here; full member settings remain editable. Saved changes apply next turn.
params.author: Author: define parameters
params.authorHelp: Bind a parameter to one or more editable fields, or insert text through its marker. Permission changes are included in the preview.
params.fieldHelp: Choose a common field or enter a path within this scope. Members use stable IDs.
params.permissionHelp: Permission edits change visibility or capabilities; inspect resolved changes.
params.valuePart: Use part of a parameter value
params.valuePath: Value path (empty uses the whole value)

budget.title: Turn resource budget
budget.help: Any exhausted limit stops this turn without publishing its body or state. Tokens are reported usage; in-flight requests may exceed the threshold.

memory.defineHelp: Bind each collection to a declared list state. Existing member permissions and rewind rules apply.
memory.title: Browse and edit memory
memory.searchHelp: Search visible fields only. Archived entries are retained and can be restored.
memory.filters: People, tags, source and time filters

event.stateHelp: Compare known before/after values. Missing old checkpoints remain unknown.
event.fromHelp: Empty matches any authorized sender; communication and context permissions still apply.
event.keywordsHelp: One per line; match input text directly. Requires current-input access.
event.cooldownHelp: Empty or 0 disables cooldown. Failed turns do not consume it; rewind restores it.

trial.title: Isolated rehearsal
trial.help: Run the real team with authored inputs in a separate data space. Closing this pane does not stop a job.
trial.name: Scenario name
trial.snapshotReady: Snapshot frozen; both variants start from the same material.
trial.includeSnapshot: Include frozen chat material, attachments and state in export
trial.trust: Allow external tools for this job
trial.trustHelp: Default: managed tools and trial workspace only. External tools may affect data outside the isolated space.
trial.scope: Each variant runs all authored inputs sequentially in its own state and memory space.
trial.adoptHelp: Loads configuration and parameters only, without trial body or accumulated state. Save to apply next turn.
trial.pending: Request submitted. Query unknown outcomes instead of starting again.
trial.range: Scope: {variants} variants × {turns} turns; at most {calls} model calls and {seconds} seconds per task.
trial.uncommitted: This attempt committed no body or state. Retry continues from the last committed checkpoint.
trial.usageUnknown: Some requests did not return complete usage. A token-limited task cannot dispatch further calls; committed results and execution records remain available.
